policy.name: pnp_v1/5000
policy.prompt: pick up the red cup and place it on the plate

fields.t: [s] since the first policy action; one sample per control tick (settings.hz)
fields.q: [rad] measured joint positions at the tick
fields.qdot: [rad/s] joint velocity command sent at the tick (after action_scale, max_speed and the joint limit guard)
fields.gripper_command: gripper state the policy asked for (action[7] <= 0.5 = open); sent when it differs and the gripper is idle
fields.action: policy action executed at the tick: 7 joint velocities + gripper (1 = closed); null = no action buffered, robot held still
fields.chunk, index: which action chunk of the rollout the action came from and its position in that chunk
fields.waypoints: the joint path reduced to waypoints (scenes of the simulation); the replay uses the trajectory
